activity.analysisPrompt: Describe the DNA you collected. For each step, explain what it did, using the cell structures from Unit 1 (cell wall, cell membrane, nucleus). A single DNA molecule is far too thin to see with your eyes. Why could you see this DNA? How did your predictions compare with what happened?

dataColumns.name: What this step does to the cell

activity.methodPrompt: Before you start, predict what each ingredient (dish soap, salt, cold alcohol) will do. Then: seal two or three strawberries in a bag with 10 mL of extraction buffer and mash for two minutes; filter the mash through a coffee filter into a tube; slowly pour an equal volume of ice-cold alcohol down the side of the tube so it forms a layer on top; wait two minutes and lift out the material that forms between the layers with a stick. Describe each step you followed, what you observed, and anything you changed.
activity.overview: Extract DNA from strawberries with household materials, and explain what each step does to the cell.
activity.question: Can we separate DNA from the other contents of a cell, and what does each step of the procedure do to the cell's structures?
activity.subject: science
activity.title: Strawberry DNA Extraction
